info.name: Retrieves All Slot Configurations of an Organization

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tracking target.

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based index number of the page of [slot configuration](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to retrieve.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `0`

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of [slot configurations](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to list per page.</br>**Minimum:** `1`</br>**Maximum:** `1000`</br>**Default:** `10`

items.docs:

params.description: The primary [seed product](https://docs.coveo.com/en/n5jg0219/glossary/seed-product) type used by recommendations strategies on this [slot configuration](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/). One of: product, cart or purchased.

info.name: Retrieves All Slot Configuration Ids & Names of an Organization

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tracking target.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter on names when requesting slot names & IDs. Will perform '*query*' match pattern.

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based index number of the page of [slot configuration](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to retrieve.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `0`

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of [slot configurations](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to list per page.</br>**Minimum:** `1`</br>**Maximum:** `1000`</br>**Default:** `10`

items.docs:
Lists all the names of the [slot configuration](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) in an [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Merchandising Hub - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"COMMERCE","targetDomain":"MERCHANDISING_HUB","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
